text:
The positive value of $λ$ for which the co-efficient of $x^{2}$
 in the expression $x^{2}$ $\left (\sqrt{x}+\frac{λ}{x^{2}}\right )^{10}$  is 720, is -
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2019 (Online) 10th January Evening Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
The general term in the expansion of the binomial expression $(a+b)^{n}$ is

$T_{r+1}={}^{n}C_{r}a^{n-r}b^{r}$

Therefore, the general term in the expansion of the binomial expression 

$x^{2}\left (\sqrt{x}+\frac{λ}{x^{2}}\right )^{10}$ is

$\begin{array}{ll} T_{r+1} & =x^{2}\left ({}^{10}C_{r}(\sqrt{x})^{10-r}\left (\dfrac{λ}{x^{2}}\right )^{r}\right ) \\  \\ ={}^{10}C_{r}x^{2}\cdot x^{\frac{10-r}{2}}λ^{r}x^{-2r} \\  \\ ={}^{10}C_{r}λ^{r}x^{2+\frac{10-r}{2}-2r} \end{array}$

Now, for the coefficient of $x^{2}$,

$\begin{array}{l} 2+\dfrac{10-r}{2}-2r=2 \\  \\ \Rightarrow \dfrac{10-r}{2}-2r=0 \\  \\ \Rightarrow 10-r=4r\Rightarrow r=2 \end{array}$

So, the coefficient of $x^{2}$ is ${}^{10}C_{2}λ^{2}=720$

$\begin{array}{ll} \Rightarrow  & \dfrac{10!}{2!8!}λ^{2}=720 \\  \\ \Rightarrow  & \dfrac{10\cdot 9\cdot 8!}{2\cdot 8!}λ^{2}=720 \\  \\ \Rightarrow  & 45λ^{2}=720 \\  \\ \Rightarrow  & λ^{2}=16 \\  \\ \Rightarrow  & λ=\pm 4 \end{array}$

Given the problem asks for the positive value of $λ$, $λ=4$.

So, the correct option is (A) 4.
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2019 (Online) 10th January Evening Slot

text: The curve amongst the family of curves represented by the differential equation, $(x^{2} – y^{2})dx + 2xy dy = 0$ which passes through (1, 1) is :
options: a circle with centre on the y-axis
an ellipse with major axis along the y-axis
a circle with centre on the x-axis
a hyperbola with transverse axis along the x-axis
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2019 (Online) 10th January Evening Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$(x^{2}$ $-$ $y^{2}) dx + 2xy dy = 0$

$\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{y^{2}-x^{2}}{2xy}$

Put   $y=vx\Rightarrow \frac{dy}{dx}=v+x\frac{dv}{dx}$

Solving we get, 

$\int \frac{2v}{v^{2}+1}dv=\int -\frac{dx}{x}$

$\ln (v^{2} + 1) =$ $-$ ln x + C

$(y^{2} + x^{2}) = Cx$

1 + 1 = C $\Rightarrow$ C = 2

$y^{2} + x^{2} = 2x$

text: Let f be a differentiable function such that f '(x) = 7 - $\frac{3}{4}\frac{f(x)}{x},$ (x > 0) and f(1) $\neq$ 4. Then $\lim _{x\to 0^{+}}\qquad$ xf$\left (\frac{1}{x}\right )$ :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2019 (Online) 10th January Evening Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$f^{'}(x)=7-\frac{3}{4}\frac{f(x)}{x}(x>0)$

Given f(1) $\neq$ 4    $\lim _{x\to 0^{+}}\qquad xf\left (\frac{1}{x}\right )=?$

$\frac{dy}{dx}+\frac{3}{4}\frac{y}{x}=7$  (This is LDE)

IF $=e^{\int \frac{3}{4x}dx}=e^{\frac{3}{4}\ln |x|}=x^{\frac{3}{4}}$

$y.x^{\frac{3}{4}}=\int 7.x^{\frac{3}{4}}dx$

$y.x^{\frac{3}{4}}=7.\frac{x^{\dfrac{7}{4}}}{\frac{7}{4}}+C$

$f(x)=4x+C.x^{-\frac{3}{4}}$

$f\left (\frac{1}{x}\right )=\frac{4}{x}+C.x^{\frac{3}{4}}$

$\lim _{x\to 0^{+}}xf\left (\frac{1}{x}\right )=\lim _{x\to 0^{+}}\left (4+C.x^{\frac{7}{4}}\right )=4$
